name: cns-skills
description: Evidence-faithful scientific manuscript revision with genre-specific writing and visual architecture, object-based biomedical scenes, cross-study synthesis, citation and clean-copy QA, and safe editable figures and tables.

interface.shortDescription: Scientific manuscript, citation, figure, and table QA
interface.longDescription: English-first manuscript and title revision with genre-specific argument and visual architecture, object-based biomedical scenes, genuine cross-study synthesis, evidence and citation audits, venue-aware tables, safe figure routing, and final-artifact QA.
defaultPrompt: Optimize this paper title, polish the SCI manuscript, and audit overclaiming.
Translate this Chinese draft into evidence-faithful academic English.
Peer-review paper; audit citations and visuals; use venue rules or neutral three-line tables; never invent experimental images.
